comment: Declarative registry of every third-party asset. Nothing binary is committed:
`npm run assets:fetch` downloads into public/assets/, verifies the hash, and
regenerates CREDITS.md. `npm run assets:verify` runs in CI and fails on an
unlicensed entry, a missing attribution, or a hash mismatch.
sha256 null means the hash has not been recorded yet. Run
`npm run assets:fetch -- --record` on a machine that can reach the host and
the hash is written back here, pinning the file from then on.
EVERY asset here is optional. role 'flora' means a model that replaces one
species' procedural shape in src/config/flora.js; with none of them fetched
the valley is drawn entirely out of procedural geometry and is complete. See
rule 4 in CLAUDE.md — this is the rule the whole renderer is built around.
The art direction is Quaternius's Nature Mega Pack: flat-shaded, chunky,
saturated, a species reduced to a dozen facets. Those files are not fetched
here because quaternius.com, poly.pizza and itch.io are all blocked by the
egress policy this project is built under; Kenney's Nature Kit is the same
language and is reachable, so it is what the manifest pins.
Every URL is pinned to a commit rather than a branch. A branch URL would
drift and fail its own recorded hash the next time upstream pushed.

assets.title: Nature Kit — pine
assets.author: Kenney
assets.notes: Replaces the procedural conifer that fills the forest.

assets.title: Nature Kit — tall pine
assets.author: Kenney
assets.notes: Replaces the narrow conifer that grows for the light.

assets.title: Nature Kit — oak
assets.author: Kenney
assets.notes: Replaces the broadleaf that takes over as the forest thins.

assets.title: Nature Kit — palm
assets.author: Kenney
assets.notes: Replaces the procedural palm. Only ever planted on a bank, so it is what dresses the oasis.

assets.title: Nature Kit — saguaro
assets.author: Kenney
assets.notes: Replaces the procedural column cactus of the deep desert.

assets.title: Nature Kit — bush
assets.author: Kenney
assets.notes: Replaces the procedural bush, in every band that carries one.

assets.title: Nature Kit — stone
assets.author: Kenney
assets.notes: Replaces the procedural boulder. A bare stone, deliberately: the kit’s rock_* models are grass-topped chunks of ground, which read as a lawn on a dune the moment one lands in the desert.

assets.title: Nature Kit — small stone
assets.author: Kenney
assets.notes: Replaces the procedural pebble, and the densest species in the scene — the one to watch in the frame budget.

assets.title: Nature Kit — fallen log
assets.author: Kenney
assets.notes: Replaces the procedural log on the forest floor.
